svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: measurement of the impedance and return loss of an antenna.
What to draw: the VNA with P1 connected, with a test lead, to the antenna connector (draw a
recognisable antenna: whip, patch or panel).
Details: the antenna far from metal objects and people: you can draw a free area around the
antenna, with a small no-entry sign on the metal or simply empty space and an arrow showing the
distance. The antenna must be in its position of use (if it is to be mounted on a roof, in the
image it is on a support, not resting on the table).
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
